decision.headline: Buy now, because Tesla is 259 basis points below the reference and no news explains it.

reasons.text: The pool price is 259 bps below the reference, which favors buying now by more than the 50 bp threshold.
The session is weekend and not anchored, but the gap is large and no material news explains it.
The trade cost is 31 bps, which is smaller than the current gap against the reference.
The desk is below the Tesla target, so this buy moves the holding toward the mandate.

rejected.reason: The market is thin on the weekend, but the price is already far below the reference and there is no news reason to expect a better reset at the reopen.
A partial buy is not needed here because the gap already favors buying now and the trade size is small.
The buy does not break the mandate and the current price gap favors acting now.
